# data-sa-056 Statistical analysis text comparison task.

## Task Instructions
Filter the data for each season by calculating the quartiles and outlier range, excluding any data outside this range. Next, perform an independent two-sample t-test to assess whether there is a significant difference in bike rental counts between weekdays and weekends. Use the resulting p-value to draw a conclusion, choosing from "Accept the null hypothesis" or "Reject the null hypothesis". Present your findings as follows:
```

}
```
